---
title: "ITF Conference on Transport Data, Statistics and Modelling in Ukraine"
abstract: "Participating in the ITF/OECD final conference on transport data and modelling in Ukraine — keynote presentation and contributions to interactive workshop exercises on open data analysis and transport modelling."
date: 2026-06-12
author:
  - "Robin Lovelace"
---

I participated remotely in the ITF/OECD final conference on transport data, statistics and modelling in Ukraine, held in a hybrid format with participants gathered in Kyiv.

The workshop programme included interactive exercises on open data analysis (using OpenStreetMap and WorldPop data in Python via Colab), case studies from Ukrainian cities, and keynote presentations on building a community of transport statistics and modelling practitioners.

My keynote — *Building a Community of Transport Statistics and Modelling Practitioners in Ukraine* — drew on experiences with open data, open source tools, and reproducible workflows in transport planning, with case studies from the UK, Spain and elsewhere.

**Slides and materials:** [github.com/Robinlovelace/itf-workshop](https://github.com/Robinlovelace/itf-workshop)
